purpose: Part 1/2 of verified inheritance-closure 11-record item effect batch 026; inherited base rules are preserved by reference and no missing mechanics are guessed.

items/standard-of-heroism.name: Standard of Heroism
items/standard-of-heroism.effectSummary: This item functions as a standard of courage, except that the standard bearer and allies within 30 feet also gain a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks.

items/ring-clumsiness-94.name: Ring of Clumsiness
items/ring-clumsiness-94.effectSummary: The ring functions exactly as a ring of feather falling, but while worn it also imposes a -4 Dexterity penalty and a 20% chance of failure when casting an arcane spell with a somatic component; this spell-failure chance stacks with other arcane spell-failure chances.

items/glyph-seal-greater-409.name: Glyph Seal, Greater
items/glyph-seal-greater-409.effectSummary: A greater glyph seal functions as a glyph seal, but can be keyed with any spell of 5th level or higher and operates as greater glyph of warding. Finding it with Search and detecting or disabling it each require DC 33.

items/horn-of-blasting-greater.name: Horn of Blasting, Greater
items/horn-of-blasting-greater.effectSummary: The greater horn functions as a horn of blasting, except its blast deals 10d6 sonic damage, stuns creatures for 1 round, and deafens them for 4d6 rounds; Fortitude DC 19 halves the damage and negates the stun and deafness. Crystalline objects take 16d6 sonic damage as with a horn of blasting, and each use carries a cumulative 20% chance that the horn explodes.

items/moon-bracers.name: Moon Bracers
items/moon-bracers.effectSummary: Moon bracers have the same abilities as bracers of armor of their listed bonus, from +1 through +8, and additionally let the wearer use dimension door once per day.

items/standard-of-no-retreat.name: Standard of No Retreat
items/standard-of-no-retreat.effectSummary: This item functions as a standard of courage and additionally blocks outward extradimensional travel within 30 feet as dimensional anchor. A creature attempting to flee the area must succeed on Will DC 19 or the attempt fails. Extradimensional travel into the area remains possible, and summoned creatures still disappear normally when their summoning ends.
